subproblems.title: Diagnose current static-LLM and controlled-experiment performance

key_points: DGM fork oracle compares raw accuracies from unequal staged subsets instead of the documented task intersection.
Plurality ties in run.py are resolved by insertion order and can flip the v2 kill conclusion.
Controlled prompts expose semantic case IDs and strongly directed evidence; 1.0 accuracy is not a credible real-distribution estimate.
AHE reports that component, experience, and decision observability make harness edits auditable.
AHE explicitly reports regression blindness even when fix attribution is reliable.
Component interactions are non-additive.
Common-task-set correction leaves only one strict DGM greedy/oracle disagreement among 11 forks; the earlier 4/11 claim is withdrawn.
DGM histories are 92.24% monotone, but shallow paths limit binary-search savings to 8.1%.
The controlled 1.0 score is a semantically revealing positive control, not a real-distribution accuracy estimate.
findings.conflict: Corrects the project's earlier raw-accuracy and controlled-accuracy interpretation.

subproblems.title: Identify precise low-cost rollback algorithms from prior work

key_points: Pointwise attribution cannot represent jointly necessary or alternative repairs.
Graph-constrained counterfactual replay recovers minimal singleton/pair repair families exactly within its declared domain.
Dependency slicing and minimality pruning reduce replay calls by about 52-55% versus exhaustive search.
A single failed trajectory is structurally insufficient for attribution.
Targeted probes ranked by information value outperform blind retries.
Attribution should update from probe outcomes and stop when evidence is sufficient.
Free-form LLM localization is stochastic and unverifiable.
Structured grounding turns semantic hypotheses into executable constraints.
Counterfactual verification adds 12 percentage points Top-1 localization in the reported benchmark.
Git bisect is logarithmic only under deterministic monotone predicates.
Flaky and non-monotone regressions break ordinary bisect.
LLM temporal analysis can improve semantic bisect but still targets first-bad behavior, not latent interacting premises.
Full ddmin recovered all clean synthetic 1-3 edge interaction causes.
A 40% dependency slice saved only 11-14% calls, killing the universal >=20% cost claim.
The retained cost gate requires a slice covering <=30% of lineage edges with audited cause recall >=95%; otherwise the method uses full ddmin.
findings.conflict: Published GCJR savings do not transfer automatically to shallow harness-patch lineages.

subproblems.title: Design and validate a pi extension and open-source evaluation workflow

key_points: File-level components, layered trajectory evidence, and change manifests are practical integration primitives.
Tools, middleware, and memory carry more transferable gains than prompt-only changes.
An auditable plugin should return a set-valued repair family rather than only a scalar edge ranking.
Replay outcomes are the success certificate; LLM guesses alone are insufficient.
The standalone pi-causal-rollback package persists checkpoint manifests and content-addressed artifact snapshots.
Its commands cover checkpoint, diagnose, status, and confirmed apply without invoking git reset.
Apply restores the rollback checkpoint and replays only later patches without declared dependencies or changed-file overlap.

uncertain_points: The closest counterfactual-replay papers operate on execution events, not harness-version patch lineages, but materially reduce novelty room.
The corrected DGM common-task-set analysis has only one strict disagreement fork, so it cannot support a statistical parent-selection claim.
Selective patch removal may fail when later harness patches depend syntactically or semantically on the removed patch.
Most 2026 sources are arXiv preprints; peer-review status is uncertain.
Real pi/SWE-bench failures have not yet established end-to-end repair success or cost savings.
